name: status
title: wsync status
description: Summarizes daemon reachability, plugin handshake, pending outbound changes, project config, sourcemap, and write-log health.
notes: Use when the task needs current daemon/plugin health or a failed live operation needs diagnosis. Existing fresh context often makes another status call unnecessary; there is no mandatory context/status startup pair.

`outbound` counts changes for Studio the daemon has not seen applied yet: `queuedChanges` not yet on the plugin connection, `unconfirmedChanges` sent since the last `wsync wait-synced` confirmed them, plus `unprocessedEvents` still in the file watcher pipeline. Run `wsync wait-synced` to drain and confirm them.
